messages:
Maya (Support): Quick sync: kernel roll for GPU fleet scheduled Wed 2026-05-20 01:00-03:00 UTC. We need final customer-facing text (status page blurb, email subject/body, SMS, and a tiny webhook JSON). Also include guidance for customers who want pinning.

Carlos (Eng Release): Drafting. Suggested tone: "planned maintenance with brief capacity transitions". We should call out expected per-host drain time: ~7-15m.

Nora (Oncall): Canary path: us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 -> ap-northeast-1. Start time should be 01:15 UTC to avoid overlap with nightly backups. Will update ops schedule.

Ibrahim (SRE): Important to include rollback policy: "If canary metrics regress, rollout will be paused and previous kernel restored." Add a note for customers: if you depend on pinned Dedicated throughput, request a temporary pin to Pool-B (v1.4.2).

Carlos (Eng Release): Status page blurb (plain):
"Planned maintenance: Wed 20 May 01:1503:15 UTC. We will apply a kernel patch to a subset of GPU hosts. During the window some Dedicated instances may be drained and restarted leading to short capacity transitions (~7-15 minutes per host). Hosted API will remain available and routing will fall back to compatible model variants. To avoid routing changes, customers can request a temporary pin to Dedicated Pool-B (v1.4.2). We will pause and rollback the rollout if we observe regressions; live updates will be posted here."

Maya (Support): Good. Please produce localized times for CN/BR and a tight SMS (<=160 chars).

Carlos (Eng Release): Local times:
- UTC: 01:15-03:15
- PDT (US west): 18:15-20:15 (previous day)
- BRT (SE3o Paulo): 22:15-00:15
- CST (China): 09:15-11:15
SMS draft: "Redwood: Planned maintenance 20 May 01:1503:15 UTC. Brief Dedicated capacity transitions possible. Status: rdw.ai/stat. Reply for pin help."

Nora (Oncall): Use rdw.ai/stat for SMS. Also add an ops note: pinned endpoints may return transient 5xx during host drains; autopilot will route but integrations should tolerate short spikes.

Ibrahim (SRE): Webhook snapshot (single-line JSON): {"event":"maintenance","start":"2026-05-20T01:15:00Z","end":"2026-05-20T03:15:00Z","impact":"capacity_transition","pin_recommendation":"pool-b:v1.4.2"}

Carlos (Eng Release): Email subject/body for pinned customers:
Subject: Redwood maintenance 20 May 1:15 UTC  brief Dedicated capacity transitions
Body:
Hi {{contact_name}},
We will perform a kernel upgrade on some GPU hosts on Wed, 20 May from 01:1503:15 UTC. You may see short Dedicated capacity transitions (~7-15m per host) while hosts are drained and restarted. If you need guaranteed Dedicated throughput during the window, reply to this message and we will coordinate a temporary pin to Pool-B (v1.4.2). We will monitor canaries and roll back if we detect regressions.
Thanks,
Redwood Support

Maya (Support): Add canned status updates for ops to paste:
- INVESTIGATING: "Maintenance in progress; some Dedicated capacity transitions observed in REGION. Mitigation ongoing."
- MONITORING: "Mitigation applied; traffic normalizing. Continuing to watch metrics."
- RESOLVED: "Maintenance complete; normal routing restored."

DeployBot: Deployment scheduled: kernel-roll/v3  start 2026-05-20T01:15:00Z. Canary failure threshold: 4. Canary path: us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 -> ap-northeast-1. Auto-rollback enabled.

NotifyBot: Reminder set: customer email batch T-24h, SMS batch T-2h. Status page publish at T-1h.

Ibrahim (SRE): Final ask: include emergency contact line and support intake for SLA customers: "For urgent SLA needs during maintenance, open an urgent support ticket and include trace ids + region; use priority contact: sla@redwood.ai."

Maya (Support): Will insert that into all messages and push to #support-alerts 24h before send. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
